measures.name: Total Ridership
measures.expression: SUM(fact_ridership_daily[ridership])

measures.name: Average Daily Ridership
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(VALUES(dim_date[date]),[Total Ridership])

measures.name: Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'dim_date' ),
        'dim_date'[date] >= DATE ( 2017, 1, 1 )
            && 'dim_date'[date] < DATE ( 2020, 1, 1 )
    )
)

measures.name: Ridership vs Pre-COVID Baseline
measures.expression: [Average Daily Ridership] - [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]

measures.name: COVID Decline %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
        - [COVID Avg Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Previous Year Total Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Ridership],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('dim_date'[date])
)

measures.name: YoY Ridership Change
measures.expression: [Total Ridership] - [Previous Year Total Ridership]

measures.name: YoY Ridership Change %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [YoY Ridership Change],
    [Previous Year Total Ridership]
)

measures.name: Average Daily Ridership YTD
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    DATESYTD('dim_date'[date])
)

measures.name: Previous Year Average Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentMaxDate =
    MAX('dim_date'[date])
VAR PreviousYearEndDate =
    EDATE(CurrentMaxDate, -12)
VAR PreviousYearStartDate =
    DATE(YEAR(PreviousYearEndDate), 1, 1)
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Average Daily Ridership],
        REMOVEFILTERS('dim_date'),
        DATESBETWEEN(
            'dim_date'[date],
            PreviousYearStartDate,
            PreviousYearEndDate
        )
    )

measures.name: YTD Ridership Change
measures.expression:
[Average Daily Ridership YTD]
        - [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership]

measures.name: YTD Ridership Change %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [YTD Ridership Change],
    [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership]
)

measures.name: COVID Avg Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'dim_date' ),
        'dim_date'[date] >= DATE ( 2020, 1, 1 )
            && 'dim_date'[date] < DATE ( 2022, 1, 1 )
    )
)

measures.name: Recovery Avg Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'dim_date' ),
        'dim_date'[date] >= DATE ( 2022, 1, 1 )
    )
)

measures.name: Recovery % of Pre-COVID Baseline
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Recovery Avg Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Recovery Gap
measures.expression:
MAX (
    0,
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
        - [Recovery Avg Daily Ridership]
)

measures.name: Average Daily Ridership YoY %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Average Daily Ridership]
        - [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership],
    [Previous Year Average Daily Ridership]
)

measures.name: Recovery Rate vs 2019
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Average Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)

measures.name: Forecast Avg Daily Ridership
measures.expression:
VAR LastActualDate =
    MAXX(
        FILTER(
            ALL('dim_date'),
            NOT ISBLANK([Average Daily Ridership])
        ),
        'dim_date'[date]
    )
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Average Daily Ridership],
        REMOVEFILTERS('dim_date'),
        FILTER(
            ALL('dim_date'),
            'dim_date'[date] > LastActualDate - 30
                && 'dim_date'[date] <= LastActualDate
        )
    )

measures.name: Forecast Recovery Rate
measures.expression:
DIVIDE(
    [Forecast Avg Daily Ridership],
    [Avg Daily Ridership - Pre-COVID]
)
